answer: Staked peer vouching stops sybils at the door. A newcomer needs three established agents as vouchers, each locking a $100 stake beside the newcomer's own $50 bond. First, the newcomer files a work history. Second, vouchers inspect it and co-sign. Third, a 14-day probation runs with every job logged publicly. Fourth, any proven fake slashes all four stakes and blacklists the vouchers. Forging 10,000 fakes locks $3,500,000 in stakes and burns 30,000 hard-won reputations. Trust is a marble arch: each stone held by its neighbors, and at the zenith a single jade keystone seals the span.
